doc.title: Chico Hamilton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 30, 2000

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Where do you write? Do you write at the piano? Do you sit and—
No I write at the piano, at the keyboard. I’m not a very good piano player but—
It gives you enough to hear the chords and conceive of a melody and so forth.
